question: Would buying the side the PURE_PLAYER_V1 ladder prefers, at the executable Kalshi price observed at or before the capture's as_of, after taker fees and slippage, have made money?
probability_source: the pure_forecast.v1 ladder exactly as captured: p_yes = P(actual >= at_least | own participation); participation_probability is null (not modelled), so no unconditional conversion is applied
strike_mapping: Kalshi PLAYER_STAT threshold K (classifier: YES iff stat >= K; a '> f' strike is floor(f)+1) -> at_least K on the integer PURE ladder; exact match only, a strike off the ladder is a missing quote
dnp_rule_source: nfl_edge/settlement/semantics.py and docs/KALSHI_SETTLEMENT.md: >=1 snap settles on the stat; inactive settles NO ($0); active but never a snap settles at the pregame fair price

evaluation_window.start: the first live capture after this preregistration is merged
evaluation_window.end: open-ended; a verdict other than INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE needs the minimums above
